comment: Independent recipe for do.c dodown() 1180-1190: a blind, levitating hero on a known down ladder. C reads the remembered levl[x][y].glyph, which shows the ladder, so the message is 'You are floating high above the ladder.'; surface() would say 'stairs'. Seed, clock and character chosen for this recipe; ^V ? H goes to Vlad's Tower level 2, which has a down ladder, ^F maps it, ^T teleports onto the ladder, #wizintrinsic sets blinded (i) and levitating (q).
